chunks: And al-Ḥalabī narrated that he asked him about a man who wants a need while he is praying, so he said:
"He gestures with his head, signals with his hand, and performs tasbih; and the woman, when she wants a need while she is praying, claps with her hands."

key_terms.الْحَاجَةَ: a need requiring attention while in prayer
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman in the ruling mentioned
key_terms.تُصَفِّقُ: she claps her hands as a signal
key_terms.يُسَبِّحُ: he says words of tasbih, glorifying Allah

ai.seo_question: How should a person signal a need while performing salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for minimal non-verbal communication during salat (prayer) when a need arises. It distinguishes between the man and the woman in how they indicate such a need while remaining in prayer.
